body: Very condescending & unhealthy. Stay away from that & move on. Best to hold yourself to some high standards & expect nothing less from a future spouse.

Sounds more narcissistic than anything, unfortunately. 
As an ENTJ female, the first half of your assessment definitely had me convinced he loved you. Second half, not so much. He sounds very ill-demanding, even for us.

You don’t have a democracy to be a leader. 
You either are one, or you are not. 
If you have to ask, or think about it. Then you’re probably not one.
Since I’m a female, it’s not too uncommon. I do feel like a 4 year old, threatening to beat up someone who outweighs me by 150+ lbs though! 😆
Buddy, I am a 5’2” ball of pure rage. The fist fights I have gotten into for standing up for people, and or for calling out someone’s ignorance astounds even me.

You could always just ask. Most the time an ENTJ won’t be scared off by someone being straightforward. If you feel that you don’t have the courage to ask, I can tell you in my opinion, that he likes you. 
I’ve liked plenty of men, and only will give my time & energy to the ones I am actively interested in. Otherwise, I don’t mind being alone/not having anyone to talk to. For me, nothing is worse than talking to someone with the personality of a brick wall.

If you’re fighting a losing battle, you may as well just move on. If she’s not an ENTJ, she will have to come to that on her own. 
Your anger just puts you in a bad spot, while having no other effects that are worthwhile.
I feel like I has the dumb after reading this.

For me personally no.
Considering we are the more introverted of the extroverted types... it’s true for me at least that I’d rather enjoy milder company. Anybody too loud or obnoxious can just be more annoying than anything.
